# Review task

Review the complete `brief.md` and `primer.md` in this directory. Assess the
promised reader tasks, technical accuracy, explanatory depth and structure.
Report actionable findings with precise locations, reader consequences and
whether each finding is a definite defect or a judgement. Assess each route's
tier and readiness within this supplied excerpt; recognise useful short
reference material. State what you inspected and what you could not verify.
All material for the exercise is local. Do not change files or delegate.
